notes.title: Tower Mechanics
notes.content:
This week we want to encourage you to ask questions and comment your thoughts. Tower mechanics of the game is the best topic to do this since our game is tower defence hybrid and we didn't reveal much on that yet. Even ingame trailer we published didn't tell much about it.

So lets talk about tower mechanics in the game!

Crafting Towers

Crafting panel asks what kind of foundation and soldier should be used. Foundations determine health of the tower and soldiers determine which weapons you can give to the soldier.


Current Foundation Types:


      Wooden Foundation: Low height, low health (few woods)

      Reinforced Wooden Foundation: Medium height, moderate health (few woods and iron)

      Stone foundation: high height, high health (wood,stone and iron)



Weapons and Ammo

After you build your tower, you can open tower panel to choose weapon and ammo. Soldier's class determines which weapons you can choose. Weapon has base damage but most important thing about the weapon is attack speed and ammo type. Because your ammo is the main damage source.


Current Ammo Types:


      Arrows- Wooden arrow, poison arrow, explosive arrow and mana shock arrow

      Grimoire- Fire magic, frost magic, lightning magic and dark magic




After you craft weapon and ammo than put them in the tower, your tower is ready to function.

notes.title: Enemy Appears!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34526871/fda10c9e3f985652eec5b9d15bfa08e71cfee5a0.jpg

Hordes of Jarl Hrafnar Sterkrson

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34526871/bf200016c6b528d5be14de84d529e938486aedde.jpg

You are not the only one who seeks Old Kingdom's treasures. Vikings are your strongest rival in this adventure.

Your real journey begins after you learn combat and basic mechanics of the game in training island. You will arrive the first Old Kingdom island and built your headquarters there. But you need to build defences not only for dangers in the island. Vikings will try to seize the island from you.

Jarl Hrafnar thinks you are weak. Therefore he sent a small ship of warriors to you first. Everytime you win your defence, he will increase number and strenght of his fleet.

This plot is our "tower defence" mechanics, we will talk about this in more detail in future.

Viking Units

[olist]
       Ulf - Basic Footman, uses one-hand axe and shield
         
            Moderate health
            Moderate damage
            Moderate defence
            Can block with shield


       Bjorn - Barbarian Brute, uses heavy battle-axe
         
            High health
            Health regeneration
            Moderate damage
            Low defence
            Ambush attack doesn't work


       Helga - Basic Archer, uses bow and arrow
         
            Low health
            Moderate damage
            Low defence
            High range
            High accuracy

[/olist]


Guardians of Old Kingdom

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34526871/f2f48e587bf63611901e2c0a6e9bd79fe52d82a1.jpg

Dark magic knowladge lost with Old Kingdom but in the ruins you will encounter with remains of Dark Knights and Dark Mages, The Undead.

Probably the reason islands of Old Kingdom vanished long ago is dark magic. Scolars think something prevented these islands to be found by some magic they don't have knowladge about. For unknown reasons this magic is faint so islands start to pop up out of nowhere.

Skeleton Units

[olist]
        Dark Knight - uses sword and shield
       
           Moderate health
           Moderate damage
           High defence
           Fast attack speed
           Can block with shield
           Ambush attack doesn't work


        Dark Mage - uses staff and grimoire
       
           Low health
           High damage
           Low defence
           Can leach health with channeling spell
           Can knockback with dark explosion spell
           Ambush attack doesn't work

[/olist]

Tribes of the Wild

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34526871/73fe2712ef118f16087920e0db87a9a9bae530a3.jpg

On second island you will encounter with an uncivilized natives, are they survivors of the Old Kingdom? That is the biggest mystery to solve.

We don't want to spoil any story you will uncover during your first island expedition. So we will just continue with unit types for now.

Tribe Units

[olist]
         Wild Fighter - uses spear and shield
        
           Low health
           Moderate damage
           Low defence
           Fast attack speed
           Fast movement speed
           Can block with shield
           Medium attack range


         Wild Scout - uses dagger
        
           Low health
           High damage
           Low defence
           Fast attack speed
           Fast movement speed
           Stealth attack


         Wild Shaman - uses staff
        
           Low health
           Moderate damage
           Low defence
           Can sacrifice friendly units to heal
           Can summon sand creatures

[/olist]


We separated Animals, Humanoids and Bosses so there are more dangers out there waiting for you. We will discuss animals and bosses in future weekly announcements. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Training Island
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34526871/f17add60266307ed55aebcd0d012e713ab81a217.jpg

You will learn how to fight in this small island before sailing

You can fight dynamically once you learn hotkeys
There are several attack types and you can combine them to create your own combos.

Attack Types and Their corresponding Hotkeys

       Light Attack - Left Mouse Button
       Heavy Attack - Shift + Left Mouse Button
       Thrust Attack - Ctrl + Left Mouse Button
       Special Attack - Alt + Left Mouse Button
       Jump/Air Attack - Shift + Space + Left Mouse Button


Defending is more important from attacking, sometimes..
There are several options for defending yourself from your enemies. You can block with your weapons and shield but how much damage you can mitigate is depending on your item's block stats. You can also parry with your weapons and dodge attacks by rolling to a direction.

Defensive Actions and Their corresponding Hotkeys

       Block - Right Mouse Button
       Parry - Alt + Right Mouse Button
       Dodge - Space bar

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34526871/f1e086ee1285a6c77c58236cb09b62a842db7c6a.jpg

In Training Island first you will learn basic movement and camera mechanics

       Character Movement - W, A, S, D
       Camera Movement - Mouse X, Y axis
       Run/Walk Toggle - CapsLock


Then you will learn targeting system and interaction with objects

       Targeting System Lock - Tab
       Change Focused Target - Q
       Interact - E
       Inventory - I
       Drop Item - R
       Equip Item - Left Mouse Button
       Assign to Actionbar - Press number of the action bar while hovering the item example: Press 1 for adding hovered item to first action bar.
 

Once you test some of the weapons on dummies, you will head to the arena for some real combat experience!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34526871/161eafe3755217a5fa9e945b64cc60ecf1f7e508.jpg

notes.title: Weapon Mechanics
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34526871/c3ea59cdcf4ae2f3a728ff9cc32580991fc0f9db.jpg

Weapon type means combat style

There are 6 types of attack actions and every weapon has its own unique attack style.

Attack types:

        Light Attack
        Heavy Attack
        Thrust Attack
        Air Attack
        Special Attack
        Ambush Attack



Attacking cost stamina based on type of the weapon and attack type.

Weapon Tiers
Using a type of weapon in battle or on training dummy rewards you experience on that weapon. When your experience bar on a weapon fills, you can upgrade your weapon to a higher tier at Engineering Table.

       Tier I Weapon: Tier I Headquarter with Blacksmith, common resources to craft.
       Tier II Weapon: Tier I version of that weapon type with full experience, Tier II Headquarter with Engineering Table, x2 Resources of Tier I version.
       Tier III Weapon: Tier II version of that weapon type with full experience, Tier III Headquarter with Engineering Table, x2 Resources of Tier I version + special upgrading item.
       Tier IV Weapon: Legendary upgrade item from bosses, Tier 3 Headquarter with Engineering Table, x2 Resources of Tier I version.



Weapon Durability
If a weapon's durability is zero, that weapon will be destroyed. As you can guess repairing your equipment is important for protecting weapons that gained experience. Repairing costs resources based on current durability.
There are three stages of durability:

      Fine
      Worn
      Battered


Weapon Types and Stats
We developed 16 weapon types so far. But this is not final, we will be adding weapon types and new equipments throughout Early Access. You can see weapon stats when you hover your mouse on the weapon in inventory.

Only thing to explain about weapon stats is that "Attack Speed" is based on the weapon type. So when you look at Tier I Greatsword you will see 0.8 Attackspeed but Katana's attack speed is 1. That doesn't mean Katana is slower than greatsword. There are more greatsword variations other than your crafting recipies. You can find these items or recipies of them by various ways that will be discussed in a later date. Lets check those 16 types of weapons: 


      Melee Weapon Types:
      One-handed Dagger
      Dual-Daggers
      One-handed Sword 
      Greatsword
      Dual-swords
      Doublesided Sword
      Katana
      Sabre
      Spear
      Polearm
      Scythe
      One-handed Axe
      Greataxe
      Maul

      Ranged Weapon Types:
      Bow
      Magical Staff


Left-Hand Equipments
We will inspect these items in detail at a later date but there are some items you can use with specific weapon type as shown below:

      Arrows -> Bow
      Shields -> One-Handed Weapons
      Grimoires -> Magical Staff and One-handed Weapons

notes.title: Crafting System
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34526871/00b9828b068ffc68a05fc67d317c1df87228f388.jpg

 Rooms and Workstations: 

 Build workstations to craft items. You can purchase blueprints of items from the library and use resources collected from the island. 


 Collectable Resources: 


   Wood
   Stone
   Leather
   Iron



 You can earn gold from killing monsters. 


 The number of workstations and their types vary depending on the tier of your base. Every workstation has a different purpose.  


   A tier I base has two workstations.


   Blacksmith: Craft weapons and shields
   Carpentery: Craft defense buildings


   A tier II base has four workstations.

   Tier I workstations.
   Barracks: Hire guards and mercenaries.
   Engineering Table: Upgrade your items to a higher tier


   Tier III Base

   Tier I and II workstations
   Alchemy Lab: Craft potions
   Temple: Learn magic and craft magic tools
